notConfigured.title: Supabase Storage is not configured yet
notConfigured.intro: The bucket and service role key are missing. Open your <link>Supabase dashboard</link> and follow these steps:
notConfigured.step1: Storage → Create a new bucket (e.g. media) and mark it public.
notConfigured.step2: Project Settings → API → copy the Project URL and the service_role secret key.
notConfigured.step3: Fill in SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET in the backend's .env (clothes-shop-api), then restart it.
